done_when: The same cold reader reads the plan again until it has no findings

dismissals.because: src/forge/story.py:418 found holds git rev-parse's return code, which is 0 when origin/<default> exists, so landed_ref returns the fetched remote ref in that case and the local branch only when there is no remote; a trap merged upstream and fetched reaches the prompt

findings.body: The new trap loader calls `landed_ref(top)`, but that helper returns the local default branch whenever `origin/<default>` exists (`src/forge/story.py:414-419`). Forge fetches the remote branch after a squash merge without advancing the local branch (`src/forge/merge.py:104`). A trap learned through an outcome fix can therefore be present on the fetched default branch yet absent from an older story’s cold-read prompt. The test advances local `main` before pushing, so it misses this case. Read the fetched remote ref and test a remote-only advancement.
findings.title: Not done: Known traps are shipped and learned

why: Gaps a plan never pins down come back as many review rounds, because the cold read runs once and nobody checks the amended plan
